expected_schedule.odd_record_rounding_note: Each native two-epoch 50% cycle uses two 405702 slices from 811405 positives, leaving one record out of that cycle; retain the native implementation.

protocol_differences: Selective authenticated direct TRAIN/raw/VALID loader replaces native OGB split/cache loader; TEST file, constructor, graph, queries and scores are absent. The constructed Data has consumed x/id/edge_index/edge_weight attributes; unused OGB processed attributes are absent. Native Collab float32 weight casting before TRAIN/VALID construction is retained.
Native TRAIN/VALID constructors, year>=2007 filter, seed reset plus real get_feature_dim query sampling are retained.

HF alias resolves to the pinned 570-byte non-weight BertConfig via a narrow local AutoConfig binding; native YAML overrides and scratch model constructor are retained. Native definitions imports temporarily use the owned source directory cwd and its empty marker; repository cwd is restored before data/model work.

One directly supervised NCCL/DDP rank on authorized GPU0 replaces author launcher default eight automatically selected GPUs; native total accumulation 8 becomes eight per rank. Explicit RANK=0/LOCAL_RANK=0/WORLD_SIZE=1 and private file:// rendezvous under the fresh owned execution root replace the elastic launcher.

Run the complete native 20-epoch recipe independently for seeds 0, 1, 2, with fresh scratch model and AdamW per seed; seed labels align with the GNNM development comparison but RNG/data/negative draws are not shared across model families.

Native train_loop/evaluate_loop/build_loaders/get_model and evaluator files remain byte-identical. Silence native training progress text, wandb_run=None; enable native Evaluator on full VALID every epoch.

Native VALID per-batch BCE remains constructed; compute_loss=False avoids aggregate loss publication. Native evaluator computes its standard Hits 20/50/100 internally; only VALID Hits@50 selects/publishes epoch scores. Full sequential VALID scores are retained only for the selected state.

Retain only the strict-best VALID Hits@50 full DDP model/AdamW/RNG state and its positive/negative VALID score arrays. First tie wins. Native all-epoch/latest checkpoint publication is replaced by this selected-only atomic artifact policy; no resume, resource state loading, donor to another fit or TEST evaluation.
Contemporary admitted Torch 2.7.1 / PyG 2.4.0 / NumPy 1.26.4 and observed ancillary versions replace author requirements Torch 2.5.1 / PyG 2.6.1 / NumPy 2.2.6; no numerical parity is claimed.
Native PENCIL bf16 autocast and TF32=True/matmul medium are retained and deliberately differ from the prior NCNC float32/TF32=False numerical profile.

Inherited ownership supervisor includes the direct DDP worker and data-loader descendants in sampled session RSS; two OMP/MKL threads and .25s allocator checks plus finite/shape/custody instrumentation are charged.

Native build_loaders remains byte-identical and creates pin_memory=True TRAIN/VALID loaders. The root harness asserts those defaults, then sets both loader.pin_memory=False before any loader iterator and asserts the effective policy. Native sampling, generator/worker seeds, batch 1024, accumulation 8, 12 workers, CPU collation, device-transfer expressions, bf16/TF32/model/optimizer schedule and full epoch/full VALID are unchanged. This transfer-only deviation bypasses the pinning API implicated in the failed v2 traceback; The completed v3 resource run supports one-epoch feasibility; root cause and numerical/performance equivalence to pinned transfer are not established.

Scientific state output allowance is 2 GiB and inclusive wall ceiling 14400 s per fit; host RSS/CUDA ceilings and sampled supervision remain the admitted profile. Binary save/fsync/hash and scalar selection/custody overhead are charged. Independent fits are serialized on the pinned GPU0 by an owned active-fit lock.

Scientific v2 sets the standard PyTorch PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True policy before any Torch import, and raises only the reserved-memory policy ceiling from 75 GiB to 80 GiB. Allocated memory remains capped at 70 GiB; the actual pinned device capacity still applies. This is an unmeasured runtime allocation adaptation, with no additional feasibility, numerical-parity or performance claim.

Supervisor session sampling rereads process birth/session identity after reading /proc status. Disappeared/replaced/out-of-session observations are omitted; the same live owned process must still expose exactly one VmRSS field. A confirmed same-birth zombie may lack RSS. Refreshed state/group data is used for closure checks. Held-child ownership, exact group signalling, bounded shutdown and no automatic retry remain unchanged.
